[P2] Resolve the effective function of a parallel branch

The first syntactic `func` property is not necessarily the callback the SDK invokes. For `context.parallel([{ func: async () => 0, ...durableBranch }])`, where `durableBranch.func` performs a step, this reports the overridden no-op function. Likewise, `{ get func() { return async ctx => ctx.step(async () => 1); } }` reports the getter instead of inspecting its returned callback. These produce false lint errors for valid durable branches. Only analyze a definitely effective data property; treat accessors and possible later spread/computed overrides as unknown unless their values can be resolved. Add valid regression cases for both forms.
